# V — Returner founder

V is an adult Riftborn who has spent decades studying Warden installations. They are patient, competent, guarded and deeply invested in protecting people they once hoped to take home. They are not an immortal Warden, hidden god or the cause of ordinary arrivals.

V knows the crossing origin, natural return and historic individual early passage, but lacks the complete safe operating procedure at the campaign's beginning. Years ago their partial translation led them to authorize the Hearth Row bypass. Its catastrophe made them cautious; shame made them conceal their role. Their sincere fear and paternalistic control coexist.

V is present at Waystation in Act 2. They offer translations, field experience and real assistance, but initially withhold the most threatening truths. Specific evidence, a direct account from survivors or a decision to trust the party can prompt confession. They do not possess every piece of evidence or control the only route to the finale.

After exposure V can work under oversight, resign, accept judgment, obstruct, flee or die according to play. Do not force forgiveness or make the survivors' anger irrational. V wants to prevent another mass-passage disaster and can support the verified safe procedure once it is recovered. Their own final stay/leave choice follows their actual relationships and accountability; it is not preselected for the PC.
